explication: The repository is a curated Docker MCP server registry and its supporting CLI tooling. The principal workflow is: a contributor creates local server metadata, validation checks its shape and remote configuration, catalog generation produces a Docker MCP catalog, and Docker tooling discovers and deploys the server. Separate flows support GitHub-assisted creation, remote MCP entries, Docker image building, and AI-assisted security review. The graph emphasizes sampled runtime paths; some publishing and build relationships are represented only where documented or directly supported by the tree.
